d: A tragic military aircraft crash in Russia has claimed the lives of all 19 people on board. The incident took place on November 17, 2026, when a military plane reportedly caught fire mid-air while flying over Russia. Within moments, the aircraft lost control and plunged towards the ground before crashing with a massive explosion. Eyewitnesses watched in shock as the burning aircraft fell from the sky. Emergency teams rushed to the crash site, but no one survived the devastating accident. What caused the aircraft to catch fire and crash? Watch this report for all the latest details.
